# CastConverter

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Execution.Functions.CastConverter`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Implements T-SQL CAST/CONVERT type conversion semantics. Supports common Dataverse types: int, bigint, decimal, float, nvarchar, varchar, datetime, date, bit, uniqueidentifier, money.

Capture source: `a0feb138f00575d35634565f3a733deb9e65ca98`, tree `904cce706d298d3f0ed62ea095bdcdd78d584101` (final-C Release candidate; not a published stable package).

#### Convert

```text
public static System.Object Convert(System.Object value, System.String targetType, System.Nullable`1<System.Int32> style = default)
```

Converts a value to the specified SQL type.

- Parameter `value`: The value to convert. Null propagates as null.
- Parameter `targetType`: The target SQL type name (case-insensitive), e.g. &quot;int&quot;, &quot;nvarchar(100)&quot;.
- Parameter `style`: Optional CONVERT style code for datetime/string formatting.

Returns: The converted value, or null if the input is null.

#### TryConvert

```text

```

TRY_CAST / TRY_CONVERT: converts a value to the specified SQL type. Returns NULL on failure instead of throwing.

- Parameter `value`: The value to convert. Null propagates as null.
- Parameter `targetType`: The target SQL type name (case-insensitive).
- Parameter `style`: Optional CONVERT style code.

Returns: The converted value, or null if conversion fails.
